scope: Seven production-only observations projected without secrets from the saved 2026-09-12 run of the admin-password-update trigger (auth-pending-trigger), recorded from a committed checkout. A pending MFA credential and SMS session held from before the transition are presented after it; whether they still start and finalize is the observed outcome, with a baseline and a final fresh completion as controls, the configuration restored with a matching whole-configuration digest, and the account deleted with UID/email absence. The approval does not extend to a production/local comparison of this corpus, to any other trigger, to a rule about revocation, to tenants, SDK or Rules.
